app.title: Sift: LSP, Lint, Format Lisp, Scheme and Emacs Lisp
app.description: A Language Server Protocol implementation with linting and formatting support for Lisp dialects, including Scheme and Emacs Lisp.
proposed_tests: Start the LSP server and connect with a minimal editor client to request diagnostics
Run `sift fmt` on a sample .lisp file and verify formatting output
Check that lint rules produce expected warnings on a deliberately malformed file
